title: smejj.com Voice Worker — ChatGPT-style voice mode (any language, low latency, barge-in), pay-per-use behind the budget gate
goal: A production-ready but NOT-deployed, self-hosted realtime voice worker for smejj.com: natural (non-robotic) neural voice, AUTOMATIC detection of EVERY spoken language with a reply in that same language, low latency via full streaming, and barge-in (interrupt). The LLM runs over the existing OpenAI-compatible smejj.com router (BYOK). Cost is controlled centrally: fail-closed start only behind the active budget gate, idle auto-shutdown, and a hard runtime cap.
requirements: STT auto-detects the spoken language (faster-whisper large-v3, language=None) — no fixed language.
Assistant replies in the SAME detected language (language-agnostic system prompt; XTTS-v2 follows the detected language for TTS).
Natural, human-sounding neural TTS (Piper HTTP self-hosted default; XTTS-v2 compatible upgrade).
Low latency through end-to-end streaming (STT partials, LLM token stream, sentence-wise TTS).
Barge-in: user speech interrupts the assistant (Silero VAD + allow_interruptions).
Fail-closed start ONLY when the budget gate is configured and approved.
Idle auto-shutdown: worker self-terminates after a configurable idle window (default 120s with no active session).
Hard runtime cap via SMEJJ_BUDGET_MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES (same key/limit the control-server watchdog lease enforces).
Stateless (no local persistence); no secrets in code (ENV/BYOK only); max 800 lines/file; Single Responsibility; platform written smejj.com everywhere.

context.modelRouter: OpenAI-compatible, model-agnostic, BYOK, fail-closed (control-server/src/llm/modelRouter.js). Reached via Pipecat OpenAILLMService(base_url=..., api_key=BYOK).
context.defaultModel: glm-5.2 (router resolves the actual backend; overridable per request).
context.workerLayer: Salad pay-per-use GPU behind budget gate + runtime watchdog (control-server/src/budget/*).
context.durableStore: IDrive e2 (only durable store on smejj.com); this worker writes nothing durable — it is stateless.
context.pattern: Follows workers/glm-salad conventions (GPU image, port 8080, /health, no secrets in image).

included: New, additive, isolated package under outputs/smejj-voice-worker/ (no repo files touched).
tests/{test_config,test_idle_shutdown}.py (+ conftest.py, _runner.py) — run without heavy deps.
docs/CONTROL_SERVER_INTEGRATION.md and docs/FRONTEND_INTEGRATION.md (PROPOSALS only, no repo edits).
excluded: No change to any file in the connected repo.
No change to design-locked frontend (composer-tools.js, voice-speech-queue.js, voice-landing.js) — integration is described, not applied.
No git, no deploy, no npm/pip install executed.
No live compute started; no paid services enabled.

howEnforced: fail-closed: config.evaluate_budget_gate mirrors control-server budgetGate.js — without a positive per-job USD cap, runtime cap, and worker budget within caps, the worker raises ConfigError and never opens a port.
idle auto-shutdown: SMEJJ_VOICE_IDLE_SHUTDOWN_SECONDS (default 120s) — no active session -> process exits -> Salad replica stops -> GPU billing ends.
runtime cap: SMEJJ_BUDGET_MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES (same key as the watchdog lease) — hard wall-clock ceiling per run, enforced locally AND by the control-server watchdog.
concurrency: SMEJJ_BUDGET_MAX_CONCURRENT_WORKERS bounds parallel voice workers.
no auto-recharge, no paid fallback; model spend only via user BYOK key.

verification.unitTests: PASS — tests/test_config.py 17/17 (budget gate + fail-closed config + auto-detect); tests/test_idle_shutdown.py 12/12 (idle + runtime cap + session counting). Run standalone without pip (no network in sandbox).
verification.integrationPending: Full Pipecat STT->router->TTS round-trip, latency and barge-in measurement require a Salad GPU node and a live microphone — not runnable in this sandbox.

rollback.strategy: Purely additive and isolated: rollback = delete the outputs/smejj-voice-worker/ directory. No repo file, no frontend, no control-server file is modified, so there is nothing to revert in the codebase.
rollback.controlServerIntegration: If later applied, the proposed control-server route is additive (new file + registration lines) and independently removable; see docs/CONTROL_SERVER_INTEGRATION.md.
rollback.frontendIntegration: If later applied, the proposed frontend switch is guarded by a capability flag and keeps the existing browser fallback + barge-in/voiceMode paths intact; see docs/FRONTEND_INTEGRATION.md.
